carFaq.priceQ: How much does it cost to rent the {model} in Dubai?
carFaq.priceA: From {today} a day today, including 5% VAT. The standard-season rate is {standard} a day and the peak-season rate (1 November to 31 March) is {peak}. Seven days cost {weekly} and 30 days {monthly}. A refundable deposit of {deposit} is held on your card, separately.
carFaq.priceOnRequestQ: How much does it cost to rent the {model} in Dubai?
carFaq.priceOnRequestA: The {model} is priced on request, from {today} a day including 5% VAT, with a minimum of {days} days. Our concierge confirms the final price on WhatsApp. The deposit is {deposit}, held on a credit card.
carFaq.priceChauffeurQ: How much does the {model} with a chauffeur cost?
carFaq.priceChauffeurA: From {hourly} an hour with a {hours}-hour minimum, {halfDay} for a half day ({halfHours} hours) and {fullDay} for a full day ({fullHours} hours), including 5% VAT. An airport transfer from DXB or DWC within Dubai costs {airport}.
carFaq.needQ: What do I need to rent the {model}?
carFaq.needA: The main driver must be {age} or older with a full licence held for at least {years} years, and a credit card in their name for the {deposit} deposit hold. Visitors bring a passport and, for some countries, an International Driving Permit. Residents bring an Emirates ID and UAE licence.
carFaq.deliveryQ: Can you deliver the {model} to my hotel or the airport?
carFaq.deliveryA: Yes. Delivery anywhere in Dubai is free for rentals of 2 days or more and {fee} each way for one day. Handover at DXB or DWC costs {airport} each way, including airport parking and meet-and-greet. You can also collect the car at our Dubai Silicon Oasis office at no charge.
carFaq.deliveryOfferA: Yes. With the Founding Client offer, delivery and collection anywhere in Dubai are free on requests until {until}. Handover at DXB or DWC costs {airport} each way, including airport parking and meet-and-greet. You can also collect the car at our Dubai Silicon Oasis office at no charge.
carFaq.escortA: In person, by our team. We deliver the car anywhere in Dubai with an escort, check your documents and give you a full briefing before you drive. We need {hours} hours' notice to prepare the car and confirm the insurance.
carFaq.selfDriveA: Yes, with our approval. Self-drive is open to drivers aged {age} or older with a licence held for at least {years} years, from {price} a day. Most guests book it with one of our chauffeurs, for weddings, airport arrivals and evenings out.
